newsitem.title: QATAR: Jordan's King Hussein arrives in Qatar.
newsitem.headline: Jordan's King Hussein arrives in Qatar.

text.p: Jordan's King Hussein arrived in Qatar on Wednesday on his second trip to the Gulf Arab state in two years.
The official Qatar news agency said Qatar Emir Sheikh Hamad bin Khalifa al-Thani greeted him at the airport.
King Hussein arrived in Qatar from Bahrain, where the official Gulf News Agency reported that he would continue to mediate between Bahrain and Qatar in their territorial row.
The king would "continue his efforts to achieve an understanding between the state of Bahrain and the state of Qatar and he hoped that his efforts will be fruitful," GNA said.
Qatar and Bahrain are in dispute over a number of barren but potentially oil and gas-rich islands, including Hawar islands, sandbanks and reefs controlled by Bahrain since the 1930s.

Bahrain has repeatedly asked Qatar to withdraw the case it took to the International Court of Justice in the Hague and accept Saudi mediation. Qatar says it will only withdraw the case from the world court if Saudi Arabia's mediation succeeded in resolving the long-standing dispute.
Prime Minister Abdul-Karim al-Kabariti, who has been promoting better ties with the Gulf since he formed his government in February, accompanied the king to the region.
In Qatar, King Hussein was expected to discuss regional developments and ways to boost economic and political ties.
